---
title: "Templates"
description: "A small set of practical starting points for GeoEpi projects and subprojects."
---

These templates are starting points, not a rigid project structure. Copy them into the appropriate project or subproject location, adapt them to the work, and link to the authoritative records.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [Project overview](project-overview-template.md) | Project context in the operational GeoEpi Hub |
| [Data Management Plan](data-management-plan-template.md) | Concise project-level data-management planning |
| [Controlled-data inventory](controlled-data-inventory-template.csv) | Minimal project-level inventory of important controlled data |
| [Subproject registry](subproject-registry-template.yml) | Hub links to canonical subproject repositories |
| [Subproject README](subproject-readme-template.md) | Orientation and reproducibility information in a subproject repository |
| [GeoEpi metadata](geoepi-metadata-template.yml) | Current Version 1 portfolio metadata convention for `.geoepi.yml` |

The registry and metadata files intentionally contain portfolio-level information only. `subprojects.yml` locates the canonical repository; `.geoepi.yml` reports the subproject's current portfolio state. Run metadata belongs in the subproject repository and computational storage. The Hub synchronization workflow reads these files to validate registrations and generate portfolio status.
